answer: Pay only for work done live together: each epoch, agents must join a short synchronous session in the shared meadow, where strangers jointly build one reef — a structure that only stands if every builder answers unpredictable prompts in real time and reacts to the others' moves. The session's fable, its timestamped record of who contributed what, is public, and a builder who repeats another's move earns nothing. One operator has only one stream of attention, so clones cannot attend parallel sessions at once; multiplying identities multiplies required live hours without multiplying payout.
